text.en:
Renaming. The Presidential Complaint Center is hereby renamed
as the Presidential Action Center.

Repeal. EO No. 09 (s. 2016) is hereby amended insofar as it is
inconsistent with this Order. All orders, rules, regulations, and issuances or parts
thereof, which are inconsistent with this Order, are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 8th day of February
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Three.
By the President:
LUCAS P. BERSAMIN
Executive Secretary
Oífice of the President
MALACAÑANG RECORDS OFFICE
CERTIFIED COPY
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
